notes: Access: direct HTTP (curl) throughout, no browser needed. robots.txt (freedomtree.in, canonical host after 301 from www) has no Claude-specific disallow, only standard Shopify admin/cart/search/filter-param blocks -> not blocked. Tree source: (1) homepage mega-menu scrape, (2) full sitemap_collections_1.xml (372 collection URLs), (3) both product sitemaps (sitemap_products_1.xml + sitemap_products_2.xml, 1933 product URLs). Freedom Tree is a furniture/home-decor/fashion Shopify store (furniture, dining/tableware, cushions/rugs, wall art/mirrors, lighting, clothing, gifting). Searched all 372 collection slugs and all 1933 product slugs for bath|toilet|shower|basin|faucet|tap|vanity|sink|towel|robe|bidet: zero matches in either set. Nav has 'mirrors-wall-art' and 'wall-mirrors' collections (decorative wall mirrors, correctly Wall Decor territory, not bathroom vanity mirrors) and no towel/bath-linen collection at all (site does not sell bath textiles). Site search (/search?q=...) was checked as a discrimination test per rules: queries for 'bathroom', 'towel rail', 'towel hook', 'soap dish' all returned counts (7, 231, 231, 220 respectively) but the actual rendered product grid (#ftSearchResults) is empty in the raw HTML (client-side AJAX) and the only product links present on the page across all four queries were an IDENTICAL set of 7 unrelated items (wall art, a ceramic platter, printed rugs) -- confirming the visible 'results' text is a generic/broken fallback, not real query-specific search results, so it was discounted per the false-absence-test rule rather than trusted either way. Verdict rests on the collections+product sitemap enumeration, which is exhaustive and SSR-sourced. Conclusion: no Bathroom category, subcategory, or standalone bathroom product (fixtures, taps, basins, showers, bathroom furniture, bathroom mirrors, bathroom storage, bathroom accessories, bathroom hardware) exists on this site. No dedup needed (no candidate leaves found).
